content.short: StreamingFast builds Firehose and Substreams, high-throughput blockchain indexing technology for The Graph.
content.description: StreamingFast is a core developer on The Graph and the team behind Firehose and Substreams, an indexing approach that streams chain data through composable transformation modules instead of replaying blocks through a handwritten indexer. Firehose nodes are built streaming-first, racing to push block data out as it is produced, which the team says allows a whole network to be processed in around five minutes. Substreams packages can be deployed and composed by other developers. API keys are self-serve and the supported chain list includes Monad, Ethereum and Solana.
